## About
Parkway Family Chiropractic is a husband and wife practice in Sugar Land. Dr. Gina Zummo-Payne grew up in the Alief/Sugar Land area, studied Human Nutrition at Texas A&M University, and went on to Texas Chiropractic College in Pasadena, where she met her husband, Dr. Scott Payne.
Our mission is to serve and strengthen our community in Fort Bend County, family by family, through chiropractic care. We look for the cause of health concerns and help you understand the choices that shape your health.
We see people at every stage of life. Whether you are trying to conceive, expecting a baby, caring for a newborn, dealing with back or nerve pain, or simply want a healthier lifestyle for your family, we would be glad to meet you.

## Services
- Chiropractic care: Safe, gentle adjustments for adults, expecting mothers, infants and kids, including craniosacral body work and the Webster technique.
- Lactation services: Help with feeding your baby, with care plans built around you and your little one.
- Spinal decompression therapy: An alternative to surgery for painful neck and back conditions such as herniated or bulging discs, degenerative disc disease, facet syndrome, sciatic leg pain, and arm pain, numbness or tingling.
- Acupuncture: Fine needles placed at specific points, used to help with blood flow, inflammation, muscle spasm, pain and range of motion, or alongside physical rehabilitation.
- Nervous system scan: Surface EMG, thermal scan and heart rate variability give a computerized picture of stress and tension on your nervous system along the spine.
- Rehabilitation: Rehabilitation equipment to help strengthen the musculoskeletal system, improve posture and reduce joint and back pain.

## FAQ
Q: Is lactation support only for breastfeeding?
A: No. Our support covers every way of feeding your baby, whether that is breast, bottle or formula.

Q: Do you see pregnant mothers and kids?
A: Yes. We care for pregnant mothers, adults and pediatric patients.
